title: "Validation: AGES vs AddNeuroMed Study"
params:
  quartile_cutoff: 0.95
---

```{r}
pacman::p_load(readxl, ggtext, rstatix, scales, viridis, RColorBrewer, install = FALSE)
```

## Introduction

This analysis compares DNA methylation effect sizes from the AGES cohort (n=2,491) with the AddNeuroMed study (n=284: 89 CTL, 86 AD, 109 MCI).

The AddNeuroMed study represents one of the first large-scale epigenome-wide association studies (EWAS) of Alzheimer's disease blood samples (Roubroeks et al., 2020, *Neurobiology of Aging*).

**Analysis parameters:** Quartile cutoff = `r params$quartile_cutoff`

## Load Data

### AddNeuroMed study data

```{r}
#| label: load-addneuromed-data

addneuromed <- read_excel(
  here("data/published_data/AD_EWAS_HOBX6_NeurologyofAging2020/AppendixA_AddNeuroMed_CTL_MCI_AD.xlsx"),
  sheet = "Supp Table 1 analysis",
  skip = 3
) |>
  clean_names() |>
  select(
    probe_id,
    difference_ct_lvs_mci,
    difference_ct_lvs_ad,
    difference_mc_ivs_ad
  ) |>
  rename(
    difference_ctl_vs_mci = difference_ct_lvs_mci,
    difference_ctl_vs_ad = difference_ct_lvs_ad,
    difference_mci_vs_ad = difference_mc_ivs_ad
  )

glimpse(addneuromed)
```

### AGES cohort association data

```{r}
#| label: load-ages-data

asso <- read_rds(here("data/upon_request/whole_genome_wide.rds")) |>
  rename_with(~str_replace(., "nlog10_p_value_(.*)", "\\1_p"), contains("nlog10_p_value")) |>
  rename_with(~str_replace(., "estimate_(.*)", "\\1_es"), contains("estimate"))

glimpse(asso)
```

## Merge Datasets

```{r}
#| label: merge-data

merged_data <- asso |>
  inner_join(addneuromed, by = c("cg" = "probe_id")) |>
  select(
    cg,
    # AGES trajectories
    normal2mci_es,
    stable_mci_es,
    normal2incid_es,
    mci2incid_es,
    prev_es,
    # AddNeuroMed comparisons
    difference_ctl_vs_mci,
    difference_ctl_vs_ad,
    difference_mci_vs_ad
  )

message("Number of CpGs in merged dataset: ", nrow(merged_data))
```

## Prepare Effect Size Data

```{r}
#| label: prepare-effect-sizes

# Pivot longer for AGES trajectories
es_ages <- merged_data |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(normal2mci_es, stable_mci_es, normal2incid_es, mci2incid_es, prev_es),
    names_to = "ages_trajectory",
    values_to = "ages_effect_size"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    ages_trajectory = str_replace(ages_trajectory, "_es", ""),
    ages_trajectory = factor(
      ages_trajectory,
      levels = c("normal2mci", "stable_mci", "normal2incid", "mci2incid", "prev")
    )
  )

# Pivot longer for AddNeuroMed comparisons
es_long <- es_ages |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(difference_ctl_vs_mci, difference_ctl_vs_ad, difference_mci_vs_ad),
    names_to = "addneuromed_comparison",
    values_to = "addneuromed_effect_size"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    addneuromed_comparison = case_when(
      addneuromed_comparison == "difference_ctl_vs_mci" ~ "MCI vs CN",
      addneuromed_comparison == "difference_ctl_vs_ad" ~ "AD vs CN",
      addneuromed_comparison == "difference_mci_vs_ad" ~ "MCI vs AD",
      TRUE ~ addneuromed_comparison
    ),
    addneuromed_comparison = factor(
      addneuromed_comparison,
      levels = c("MCI vs CN", "AD vs CN", "MCI vs AD")
    )
  )
```

### Apply Quartile Filtering

```{r}
#| label: apply-quartile-filtering

# Apply quartile filtering per facet (addneuromed_comparison + ages_trajectory)
if (params$quartile_cutoff < 1) {
  lower_q <- (1 - params$quartile_cutoff) / 2
  upper_q <- 1 - lower_q

  es_long_filtered <- es_long |>
    mutate(
      x_lower = quantile(ages_effect_size, lower_q, na.rm = TRUE),
      x_upper = quantile(ages_effect_size, upper_q, na.rm = TRUE),
      y_lower = quantile(addneuromed_effect_size, lower_q, na.rm = TRUE),
      y_upper = quantile(addneuromed_effect_size, upper_q, na.rm = TRUE),
      .by = c(addneuromed_comparison, ages_trajectory)
    ) |>
    filter(
      ages_effect_size >= x_lower & ages_effect_size <= x_upper,
      addneuromed_effect_size >= y_lower & addneuromed_effect_size <= y_upper
    ) |>
    select(-x_lower, -x_upper, -y_lower, -y_upper)
} else {
  es_long_filtered <- es_long
}

message("CpGs after filtering: ", n_distinct(es_long_filtered$cg))
```

## Correlation Analysis

```{r}
#| label: correlation-analysis

es_corr <- es_long_filtered |>
  group_by(ages_trajectory, addneuromed_comparison) |>
  rstatix::cor_test(
    ages_effect_size,
    addneuromed_effect_size,
    method = "spearman"
  ) |>
  select(ages_trajectory, addneuromed_comparison, cor, p) |>
  mutate(
    cor_label = glue("r = {round(cor, 3)}; p = {format.pval(p, digits = 3)}")
  )

# Display correlation results
es_corr |>
  select(ages_trajectory, addneuromed_comparison, cor, p) |>
  mutate(
    cor = round(cor, 3),
    p = format.pval(p, digits = 3)
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(caption = "Spearman correlations between AGES and AddNeuroMed effect sizes")
```

### Prepare Scatter Plot Correlation Labels

```{r}
#| label: prepare-scatter-labels

# Create correlation labels with parsed expressions for scatter plots
scatter_correlations <- es_long_filtered |>
  summarise(
    cor_test = list(cor.test(ages_effect_size, addneuromed_effect_size, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")),
    n_cpgs = n_distinct(cg),
    .by = c(addneuromed_comparison, ages_trajectory)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    cor_estimate = map_dbl(cor_test, ~.$estimate),
    cor_pval = map_dbl(cor_test, ~.$p.value),
    # Parsed expression labels for italic r and P
    cor_estimate_label = glue("italic(r) == ~{round(cor_estimate, 2)}"),
    cor_pval_label = glue("italic(P) == ~{display_scientific_notation(cor_pval)}")
  ) |>
  select(-cor_test)
```

## Scatter Plot: All Comparisons

```{r}
#| label: fig-scatter-all
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 8

scatter_all_plot <- es_long_filtered |>
  ggplot(aes(x = ages_effect_size, y = addneuromed_effect_size)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = FALSE, color = "blue", linewidth = 0.8) +
  # Correlation coefficient (r) with parsed expression
  geom_label(
    data = scatter_correlations,
    aes(label = cor_estimate_label),
    x = I(0.05),
    y = I(0.95),
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 0.5,
    color = "darkred",
    fill = "grey90",
    label.size = NA,
    size = 3,
    parse = TRUE
  ) +
  # P-value with parsed expression
  geom_label(
    data = scatter_correlations,
    aes(label = cor_pval_label),
    x = I(0.05),
    y = I(0.90),
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 0.5,
    color = "darkred",
    fill = "grey90",
    label.size = NA,
    size = 3,
    parse = TRUE
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray") +
  facet_grid(
    rows = vars(addneuromed_comparison),
    cols = vars(ages_trajectory),
    scales = "free"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = glue("Effect size of AGES cohort <br> <span style = 'font-size:8pt'> (N<sub>Subjects</sub> = 2,491) </span>"),
    y = "Effect size of AddNeuroMed study <br> <span style = 'font-size:8pt'> (N<sub>Subjects</sub> = 284) </span>",
    title = "Whole-Genome EWAS Comparison: AGES vs AddNeuroMed",
    subtitle = "Correlations across dementia categories and diagnostic comparisons"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_textbox(halign = 0.5),
    axis.title.y = element_textbox(halign = 0.5, orientation = "left-rotated"),
    strip.text.x = element_textbox_simple(halign = 0.5, lineheight = 1.2, margin = margin(8, 2, 2, 2)),
    strip.text.y = element_textbox_simple(halign = 0.5, orientation = "right-rotated", lineheight = 1.2, margin = margin(2, 8, 2, 2)),
    strip.placement = "outside",
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12)
  )

print(scatter_all_plot)
```

## Scatter Plot: Two Key Comparisons

Filter to show only CTL vs MCI and CTL vs AD comparisons (omitting MCI vs AD).

```{r}
#| label: fig-scatter-two
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 6

# Filter data for two key comparisons
two_key_comparisons <- c("MCI vs CN", "AD vs CN")

es_long_filtered_two <- es_long_filtered |>
  filter(addneuromed_comparison %in% two_key_comparisons) |>
  mutate(addneuromed_comparison = fct_drop(addneuromed_comparison))

scatter_correlations_two <- scatter_correlations |>
  filter(addneuromed_comparison %in% two_key_comparisons) |>
  mutate(addneuromed_comparison = fct_drop(addneuromed_comparison))

# Filter for key trajectories (3 trajectories)
key_trajectories <- c("normal2incid", "mci2incid", "prev")

es_long_filtered_key <- es_long_filtered |>
  filter(ages_trajectory %in% key_trajectories) |>
  mutate(ages_trajectory = fct_drop(ages_trajectory))

scatter_correlations_key <- scatter_correlations |>
  filter(ages_trajectory %in% key_trajectories) |>
  mutate(ages_trajectory = fct_drop(ages_trajectory))

# Filter for key trajectories + two key comparisons (3 trajectories x 2 comparisons)
es_long_filtered_two_key <- es_long_filtered |>
  filter(
    ages_trajectory %in% key_trajectories,
    addneuromed_comparison %in% two_key_comparisons
  ) |>
  mutate(
    ages_trajectory = fct_drop(ages_trajectory),
    addneuromed_comparison = fct_drop(addneuromed_comparison)
  )

scatter_correlations_two_key <- scatter_correlations |>
  filter(
    ages_trajectory %in% key_trajectories,
    addneuromed_comparison %in% two_key_comparisons
  ) |>
  mutate(
    ages_trajectory = fct_drop(ages_trajectory),
    addneuromed_comparison = fct_drop(addneuromed_comparison)

scatter_two_plot <- es_long_filtered_two |>
  ggplot(aes(x = ages_effect_size, y = addneuromed_effect_size)) +

    fill = "grey90",

    size = 3.5,
```

## Bar Plot: All Comparisons

```{r}
#| label: fig-barplot-all
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 10

# Prepare data with significance categories
barplot_data <- es_corr |>
  mutate(
    significance_level = case_when(
      p < 0.001 ~ "p < 0.001",
      p < 0.01 ~ "p < 0.01",
      p < 0.05 ~ "p < 0.05",
      TRUE ~ "p >= 0.05"
    ),
    significance_level = factor(
      significance_level,
      levels = c("p < 0.001", "p < 0.01", "p < 0.05", "p >= 0.05")
    ),
    # Create labels for the bars
    cor_label_full = paste0(
      round(cor, 3),
      ifelse(p < 0.001, "***",
             ifelse(p < 0.01, "**",
                    ifelse(p < 0.05, "*", "")))
    ),
    # Enhanced trajectory labels
    trajectory_label = case_when(
      ages_trajectory == "normal2mci" ~ "Normal->MCI",
      ages_trajectory == "stable_mci" ~ "Stable MCI",
      ages_trajectory == "normal2incid" ~ "Normal->Incident",
      ages_trajectory == "mci2incid" ~ "MCI->Incident",
      ages_trajectory == "prev" ~ "Prevalent",
      TRUE ~ as.character(ages_trajectory)
    )
  )

# Create enhanced grouped bar plot
barplot_all <- barplot_data |>
  ggplot(aes(x = ages_trajectory, y = cor)) +
  geom_col(
    aes(fill = significance_level, alpha = abs(cor)),
    color = "white", linewidth = 0.8, width = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(-0.2, 0.2), linetype = "dotted", color = "gray60", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(-0.1, 0.1), linetype = "dotted", color = "gray80", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = cor_label_full,
      y = ifelse(cor >= 0, cor + 0.025, cor - 0.025),
      color = significance_level
    ),
    size = 3.5,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ addneuromed_comparison, ncol = 3,
    labeller = labeller(addneuromed_comparison = c(
      "MCI vs CN" = "MCI vs CN\n(n=109 vs n=89)",
      "AD vs CN" = "AD vs CN\n(n=86 vs n=89)",
      "MCI vs AD" = "MCI vs AD\n(n=109 vs n=86)"
    ))
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Statistical\nSignificance",
    values = c(
      "p < 0.001" = "#440154",
      "p < 0.01" = "#31688E",
      "p < 0.05" = "#35B779",
      "p >= 0.05" = "#FDE725"
    ),
    guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1))
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Statistical\nSignificance",
    values = c(
      "p < 0.001" = "white",
      "p < 0.01" = "white",
      "p < 0.05" = "black",
      "p >= 0.05" = "black"
    ),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  scale_alpha_continuous(range = c(0.6, 1), guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(-0.3, 0.4),
    breaks = seq(-0.3, 0.4, 0.1),
    labels = function(x) ifelse(x == 0, "0", sprintf("%.1f", x))
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c(
    "normal2mci" = "Normal->\nMCI",
    "stable_mci" = "Stable\nMCI",
    "normal2incid" = "Normal->\nIncident",
    "mci2incid" = "MCI->\nIncident",
    "prev" = "Prevalent"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "DNA Methylation Effect Size Correlations: AGES vs AddNeuroMed Cohorts",
    subtitle = "Spearman correlations between dementia trajectories (AGES, n=2,491) and diagnostic comparisons (AddNeuroMed, n=284)\nBars show correlation strength with significance indicators (* p<0.05, ** p<0.01, *** p<0.001)",
    x = "AGES Dementia Trajectories",
    y = "Spearman Correlation Coefficient",
    caption = "Bar transparency reflects correlation magnitude; text labels show exact values with significance stars"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16, face = "bold", margin = margin(b = 5)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 12, margin = margin(b = 15)),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10, color = "gray50"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 10, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", margin = margin(t = 10)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", margin = margin(r = 10)),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11, margin = margin(b = 10, t = 10)),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = "gray80"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "gray90", linewidth = 0.5),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "gray80", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5)
  )

print(barplot_all)
```

## Bar Plot: Two Key Comparisons

```{r}
#| label: fig-barplot-two
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 8

# Filter barplot data for two key comparisons
barplot_data_two <- barplot_data |>
  filter(addneuromed_comparison %in% two_key_comparisons) |>
  mutate(addneuromed_comparison = fct_drop(addneuromed_comparison))

# Create bar plot for two key comparisons
barplot_two <- barplot_data_two |>
  ggplot(aes(x = ages_trajectory, y = cor)) +
  geom_col(
    aes(fill = significance_level, alpha = abs(cor)),
    color = "white", linewidth = 0.8, width = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(-0.2, 0.2), linetype = "dotted", color = "gray60", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(-0.1, 0.1), linetype = "dotted", color = "gray80", alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ addneuromed_comparison, ncol = 2,
    labeller = labeller(addneuromed_comparison = c(
      "MCI vs CN" = "MCI vs CN\n(n=109 vs n=89)",
      "AD vs CN" = "AD vs CN\n(n=86 vs n=89)"
    ))
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Statistical\nSignificance",
    values = c(
      "p < 0.001" = "#440154",
      "p < 0.01" = "#31688E",
      "p < 0.05" = "#35B779",
      "p >= 0.05" = "#FDE725"
    ),
    guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1))
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Statistical\nSignificance",
    values = c(
      "p < 0.001" = "white",
      "p < 0.01" = "white",
      "p < 0.05" = "black",
      "p >= 0.05" = "black"
    ),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  scale_alpha_continuous(range = c(0.6, 1), guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(-0.3, 0.4),
    breaks = seq(-0.3, 0.4, 0.1),
    labels = function(x) ifelse(x == 0, "0", sprintf("%.1f", x))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "DNA Methylation Effect Size Correlations: AGES vs AddNeuroMed (Two Key Comparisons)",
    subtitle = "Spearman correlations: MCI vs CN and AD vs CN comparisons\nBars show correlation strength with significance indicators (* p<0.05, ** p<0.01, *** p<0.001)",
    x = "AGES Dementia Trajectories",
    y = "Spearman Correlation Coefficient"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold", margin = margin(b = 5)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 11, margin = margin(b = 15)),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10, color = "gray50"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 10, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", margin = margin(t = 10)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", margin = margin(r = 10)),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11, margin = margin(b = 10, t = 10)),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = "gray80"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "gray90", linewidth = 0.5),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "gray80", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5)
  )

print(barplot_two)
```
